Frequently Asked Questions (UAE Corporate Tax)

Under Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, taxable net profit up to AED 375,000 is subject to 0% Corporate Tax. Taxable profit exceeding AED 375,000 is taxed at a flat rate of 9%.
